scope: Replace hard-coded 5-room array + three 'server rollout pending' placeholders in CommunityChatHome.tsx with a live useCommunity() fetch. Widen backend ALLOWED_CHANNELS to accept every slug seeded by seed_community_channels.py. Add a #bugs channel + 'Report a bug' CTA that pre-fills a diagnostics template. NOT in scope: version bump, install-metrics files, release infra.

findings.summary: ALLOWED_CHANNELS is a hardcoded set that duplicates the SEEDS list in seed_community_channels.py. If Daniel adds a new seeded slug in the future, forgetting to add it here will silently 400 the composer.
findings.evidence: The set is a literal Python constant, not derived from the CommunityChannel table. Documented via inline comment ('Keep in lock step with SEEDS ...') but not asserted at runtime.
findings.reproduce: Add a new SEED slug to seed_community_channels.py without updating ALLOWED_CHANNELS · POST /chat/message with that slug returns 400 'unknown channel'.
findings.suggested_fix: Follow-up (not this diff): compute ALLOWED_CHANNELS lazily from CommunityChannel table on router startup, or add a lifespan-time assertion that every SEED slug is present in ALLOWED_CHANNELS. Deferred to keep this diff focused on the drift bug.
findings.addressed_notes: Accepted as documented follow-up · inline comment + Report receipt log the constraint.

findings.summary: When useCommunity() is still loading, the room list falls back to a single-room array containing only #global. A user who lands on Community before /community/channels resolves briefly sees 1 room instead of the loading skeleton.
findings.evidence: 'rooms = useMemo(() => community.rooms.length === 0 ? [fallbackRoom] : ...)'. The skeleton IS rendered by the room-loading branch, but only when 'community.loading && community.rooms.length === 0'. The fallbackRoom itself is never displayed under normal flow since useCommunity() populates channels within ~100ms on a healthy backend.
findings.reproduce: Slow the network to 5s+ round-trip and open Community — the skeleton renders as expected; fallbackRoom is a defensive last-resort for the case where community.error trips (see error branch).
findings.suggested_fix: Reviewed as acceptable · the skeleton is the primary state, fallbackRoom is a safety net so the composer stays usable if /community/channels hard-fails.
findings.addressed_notes: Design accepted · defensive fallback + explicit loading skeleton + error card cover all three states (loading / error / empty).

findings.summary: ChatChannel widened from literal union 'global' | 'agency-vip' to string. This weakens compile-time safety at the ChatPanel + composer call sites.
findings.evidence: ChatPanel.tsx:471 uses useState<ChatChannel>(...); the setter now accepts any string. In practice ChatPanel still assigns only the two legacy literals via its tab handler, so runtime behavior is unchanged.
findings.suggested_fix: Accepted trade-off · the alternative is threading the seed-derived slug union through TypeScript (which would need a build-time codegen from seed_community_channels.py). ALLOWED_CHANNELS enforcement lives at the backend HTTP boundary (400 on unknown), which is the correct source of truth once the frontend can point at seeded slugs.
findings.addressed_notes: Explicitly documented in the widening comment. Runtime validation preserved.

verdict_notes: Live round-trip walk in Chromium against local backend + fresh SQLite confirms: (1) /community/channels returns 10 rooms including #bugs, (2) Report-a-bug CTA pre-fills 210 chars of diagnostic template, (3) message POST -> GET round-trips, (4) message persists across full app reload. Zero 'server rollout pending' strings remain in the DOM. Four screenshots at 08_receipts/chat-drift-fix-2026-07-08/screenshots/. Backend curl regression: legacy 'global' and 'agency-vip' still work; unknown slug returns 400. tsc --noEmit and py_compile both clean. All identified findings are P2 documented follow-ups or accepted trade-offs — no P0/P1 blockers on this diff.
not_in_scope: release workflow / bundle.resources / tauri config / lib.rs (touched by parallel work per handoff)
